notes: Ground heat magnitudes, source discharges, pool edge temperatures, pool radial profiles, and most pool depths include authored assumptions. Pool center temperatures are single published samples where the pool entity names a measured basis.
Steady outflow, plume, and pool fields do not represent a common evolving temperature trajectory.
Missing raster pixels remain missing. Display sample areas are not additional physical observations.
